name: AKT1 mutation
summary: The AKT1 E17K mutation is an activating alteration in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, generally mutually exclusive with PIK3CA mutations, that predicts benefit from AKT inhibition.
biology: AKT1 is a serine/threonine kinase activated downstream of PI3K. E17K in the pleckstrin homology domain alters lipid binding, causing constitutive membrane localisation and pathway activation independent of upstream PI3K activity.

testing.specimen: Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tumour tissue or plasma ctDNA

predictiveRelevance: AKT1 alterations are part of the biomarker set (PIK3CA, AKT1, PTEN) selecting patients for capivasertib plus fulvestrant.
